errors.text_span: Тя започва около 30 000 хил. лв. през 2018 г., постепенно нараства до около 40 000 хил. лв. през 2020 г., след което се стабилизира и леко спада до около 38 000 хил. лв. през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description of the blue line's trend is entirely incorrect. It starts at approximately 23,000 in 2018 (not 30,000), rises to about 30,000 in 2020 (not 40,000), and continues to rise to nearly 40,000 by 2022 (it does not stabilize and then fall).

errors.text_span: Тя започва около 15 000 хил. лв. през 2018 г., постепенно нараства до около 20 000 хил. лв. през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the orange line starts at 15,000 and grows. In the chart, the orange line starts at approximately 20,000 and remains flat or slightly decreases until 2020.

errors.text_span: до около 18 000 хил. лв. през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The orange line ends at a value closer to 15,000, not 18,000, in 2022.

errors.text_span: Тя започва около 150 000 хил. лв. през 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The grey line starts visibly above the 150,000 mark, at approximately 160,000.

errors.text_span: достига около 230 000 хил. лв. през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The final value for the grey line is significantly higher, ending just below 250,000 (at approximately 245,000), not 230,000.
